title: File exceeds 1000 lines (2340 lines)
detail: File is 2340 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 4 sites (L379,L584,L622,L723)
detail: `except Exception` catches all exceptions without re-raising, swallowing unexpected errors silently. This hides failures and makes the caller unable to distinguish success from silent failure. Suggested fix: catch only the exception types the callee can raise, or use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()` for cleanup handlers.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 2 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L1147,L1172)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Unpacked output variable(s) silently discarded: cpu_map at L820
detail: Function returns a tuple; one or more unpacked variables are never read. If the discarded variable carries error information (e.g. stderr from a subprocess call), silent discard means errors go unlogged. Suggested fix: check or log the discarded value, or use `_` if intentional.
